description: Discovery sources for ambience candidates. This registry helps humans and agents search broadly; it is never consulted during rendering.

sources.label: Openverse
sources.notes: Aggregator for openly licensed media; verify licence at the original source.

sources.label: Freesound
sources.notes: Rich field-recording corpus; licence varies per sound.

sources.label: Pixabay Sound Effects
sources.notes: Large sound-effects catalog; verify current provider terms for each production.

sources.label: ZapSplat
sources.notes: Large sound-effects and ambience catalog; provider terms depend on asset/account.

sources.label: Mixkit
sources.notes: Free sound-effects collection; verify current provider terms.

sources.label: Sonniss GameAudioGDC
sources.notes: Professional free bundles; raw redistribution rules must be checked.

sources.label: Free To Use Sounds
sources.notes: Field recordings and immersive material; verify current licence and redistribution rights.

sources.label: Soundly
sources.notes: Professional search/library service; raw assets are generally production inputs, not public repo content.

sources.label: BOOM Library
sources.notes: Professional sound-effects library; use under applicable licence.

sources.label: Pro Sound Effects
sources.notes: Professional sound-effects library; use under applicable licence.

sources.label: Pond5
sources.notes: Large marketplace useful for hard-to-find material; verify licence per acquisition.
